title: Canvas 2D drawing and animation loop
when: The user wants animated graphics, a simple game, particles, a drawing pad or a visualization drawn on a canvas.
prompt:
Goal: A sharp, resizable canvas with a fixed timestep loop that runs smoothly, pauses when hidden and stays accessible.
Steps:
1. Sharpness: canvas.width = cssWidth * devicePixelRatio (same for height) and ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0); redo in a ResizeObserver.
2. Loop with requestAnimationFrame; dt from the timestamp, clamped to 0.1 s after tab switches.
3. Update in fixed steps of 1 / 60 s with an accumulator, draw once per frame.
4. Draw order: clearRect, background, world, interface; save and restore around transforms.
5. Keep update(state, dt) and draw(ctx, state) separate so logic is testable; convert pointer events to canvas coordinates.
6. Pause on visibilitychange; respect prefers-reduced-motion; give the canvas role="img" and an aria-label or a text description.
Quality bar:
- No blur on dense screens.
- Steady frame rate for the intended scene.
- Speed is the same on 60 and 144 Hz displays.
Pitfalls:
- Sizing the canvas only in CSS, which stretches pixels.
- Movement per frame instead of per second.
- Allocating objects every frame in hot loops.
Verify:
- [ ] devicePixelRatio handled.
- [ ] Fixed step update with clamped dt.
- [ ] visibilitychange pauses.
- [ ] Canvas has a text alternative.
Output: index.html with the canvas, js/loop.js, js/scene.js (update and draw) and style.css.

examples.input: animação de partículas que seguem o mouse
examples.output: canvas sized by dpr, fixed step particles update, pointermove attractor, pause when hidden
